stem: The Culper Ring used Dr. Jay’s invisible ink rather than lemon juice because Dr. Jay’s ink was —

options.label: A
options.text: more difficult for an enemy to discover

options.label: B
options.text: Washington’s preferred way to send a message

options.label: C
options.text: suitable for writing between the lines of a letter

options.label: D
options.text: a symbol of British support for the Americans
